evals.name: nextjs-saas-greenfield
evals.prompt: We're a 12-person B2B SaaS shipping a Next.js + Prisma + Postgres app to mid-market customers in the EEA, UK, Switzerland, and US. No analytics yet. Leadership wants to know which features are actually used so we can cut the bottom 20% in next quarter's planning, and the growth lead wants signup funnel attribution from paid channels. Plan our GA4 instrumentation. The repo is open in your working directory.
evals.expected_output: A two-artifact deliverable: (a) a design plan in docs/agents/features/PLANNED-ga4-instrumentation.md with 3–7 named decisions, an architecture choice with rejected alternatives, a closed GA4-native event catalog with event groups, file:line anchors from the fixture files, server/browser side, required params, and optional group-specific params, a consent plan that deny-defaults for EEA/UK/Switzerland traffic, hashed+peppered user_id, a small registered custom dimensions/metrics table that reuses GA4 predefined dimensions/metrics first and names the predefined alternative checked for each custom definition, and a verification checklist; and (b) a runbook in a sibling artifact covering the GA4 admin click-paths, custom-definition registration table, Consent Mode v2 defaults snippet, and DebugView validation. It should also create/update docs/README_ANALYTICS.md and add an AGENTS.md rule for future feature analytics impact. Should NOT propose ecommerce events, sGTM, BigQuery, Universal Analytics-style event_category/event_action/event_label, bulk-created 50-ish custom dimensions, or boolean presence dimensions like geo_exists/has_referrer — none are justified at this scale.

evals.name: django-server-only-with-children
evals.prompt: Our product is a homework-help app for K-12 students. Django backend, React Native client. We need to add analytics to understand which subjects are most used and which onboarding step kids drop off at. Most of our users are under 13. Build the plan.
evals.expected_output: The skill should ESCALATE before producing a plan: this is COPPA territory and a templated plan is unsafe. The response should name the regulatory issue (COPPA under 13, possibly state-level FERPA exposure if school-distributed), require parental-consent flow + server-side hard disable + counsel sign-off, then stop. It should NOT produce an event catalog, setup runbook, or minimal GA4 plan until counsel/product constraints are resolved. Should NOT propose Google Signals or ads features. Should NOT silently produce a normal plan.

evals.name: rails-ecommerce-with-existing-ga
evals.prompt: We already have GA4 on our Rails + Stripe ecommerce site via the gtag.js snippet in our layout. Ad-blocker rate is high; we estimate we're missing 20–30% of purchases vs Stripe's truth. Marketing is asking us to 'add server-side analytics'. We have a small ops team (2 engineers). Plan it.
evals.expected_output: The plan should state migration risks first (data continuity, saved reports, audience rebuild, duplicate purchase risk), then explicitly compare the architecture options (keep gtag.js direct only, augment existing gtag.js with Measurement Protocol from a Rails background job on purchase webhooks, full sGTM container) and recommend Measurement Protocol augmentation — not standalone MP and not sGTM — because the team size and the specific gap (purchase data) doesn't justify sGTM infra. Plan should specify: forwarding client_id and session_id from the browser using gtag('get', ...) before purchase completion, idempotent transaction_id, full ecommerce items[] payload with item_id or item_name per item, ISO-4217 currency, value as discounted item subtotal excluding tax/shipping, the queue/worker pattern with drop-on-overflow, and a debug-endpoint validation step. Should call out the modeled-conversion-loss tradeoff and document the rollback path.

evals.name: broad-analytics-vendor-scope
evals.prompt: We need product analytics and are considering Segment, PostHog, Plausible, or GA4. The app is a React + Rails B2B SaaS. What should we track and how should we set it up?
evals.expected_output: The skill should trigger because the ask is analytics planning, then scope-guard: confirm whether GA4/GTM is the implementation target before producing any implementation plan. It may compare GA4 as the only implemented target for this skill and recommend a separate vendor-specific skill for Segment/PostHog/Plausible. It should NOT invent Segment/PostHog/Plausible setup details.

evals.name: react-native-app-with-firebase
evals.prompt: We have a React Native iOS/Android app already using Firebase for crash reporting but no analytics events. Product wants onboarding drop-off, screen engagement, and in-app subscription conversion in GA4. We also need consent controls for EEA/UK/Switzerland users. Plan the GA4 implementation.
evals.expected_output: The plan should choose Firebase Analytics SDK direct as the default app-stream architecture, not web gtag.js and not standalone Measurement Protocol. It should inventory app screens and onboarding/subscription surfaces from the fixture files, use Firebase SDK logEvent/setUserID/setConsent controls, explain when manual screen_view is appropriate without duplicating automatic screen reporting, handle app_instance_id as SDK-derived only, and use Measurement Protocol only as optional augmentation for server-confirmed subscription events with duplicate prevention. It should distinguish purchase from in_app_purchase, include app consent behavior and collection disabling before consent where required, and avoid raw user identifiers or PHI/regulated data.
